messages:
sophia: Heads-up — I kicked off a dev cluster bring-up for qat+ptq reranker (qatr-rerank-3b). Aggregate NDCG looks OK but we're seeing a JP-specific MRR dip (~5%). Anyone seen quant/kernel interactions that are locale-specific?

kevin: can you share the exact eval command and slices used? need cold vs warm cache breakdowns.

lia: eval command pasted below (running on eval-harness v2):
```bash
python eval_harness.py --model qatr-rerank-3b --tasks jp_passage,jp_longpass,en_passage --metrics mrr,ndcg@10 --quant ptq-int8 --tokenizer ja_norm_v3 --preproc strip_code=true --batch 128 --slices cache_state,query_len
```
quick results: jp_passage MRR -0.051, ndcg@10 -0.004; en_passage MRR +0.008. Cold MRR delta -0.02, warm MRR delta -0.09.

tom: warm amplification suggests kv cache/prefix path problem. Did runtime kernels change for cache path?

lia: yes, we enabled fast-cudnn matmul for the cached path to save latency. I dumped kv-key hex hashes for a failing example and compared fp32 vs ptq: cosine sim 0.997 vs usual 0.999. Small but apparently cascades with cached prefix.

ops-bot: perf-alert: fast-cudnn-matmul enabled for qatr-rerank-3b at 2024-06-01T09:12Z.

kevin: try flipping the kernel to deterministic matmul on a subset and re-run. Also compare per-channel vs per-tensor PTQ.

lia: ran deterministic matmul on a 1k sample: warm MRR delta improved to -0.009 (from -0.09). FP16 baseline with deterministic kernel matches fp32 within noise. PTQ per-channel run pending.

sophia: good detective work. Action items: 1) lia re-run per-channel PTQ + deterministic kernel and produce top1 swap list (limit 100) split by cache_state and query_len — EOD 2) kevin add unit tests for kv reproducibility for common JP token patterns (dates/place names/kana-kanji combos) — tomorrow 3) ops gate fast-cudnn kernel behind locale canary and don't roll JP traffic until confirmed.

lia: example failing pair (masked for PII):
- query: "\u540d\u524d \u53e4\u5e74\u8857\u306e\u30ab\u30d5\u30a7"
- fp32 top1 doc: contains exact phrase (score 4.05)
- ptq top1 doc: broader match (score 3.89)
- score diffs: fp32 A=4.05 B=3.92; ptq A=3.89 B=3.96

kevin: tiny token-level kv perturbation explains flip. We should also check tokenizer normalisation: fullwidth punctuation, zero-width spaces, and tag stripping. Maybe strip_code aggressively removes tokens adjacent to CJK chars.

lia: toggled strip_code=false => jp_mrr recovers to -0.01 under ptq in initial checks. So preproc+ptq+kernel combo is the root cause.

sophia: proposed immediate mitigation: revert fast-cudnn kernel for jp canary, make strip_code locale-aware, and continue per-channel ptq experiments. If deterministic kernel + per-channel ptq fixes it we can re-enable fast kernel behind perf guardrails.

eval-bot: Eval finished (2024-06-01T12:10Z): qatr-rerank-3b PTQ-int8 aggregate NDCG@10 delta -0.004, MRR delta -0.049 on jp_passage. Warm-cache swap rate: 7.2% (72/1000). Deterministic-matmul run: MRR delta -0.009.

sophia: thanks all. Hold rollout for now. We'll sync during standup and push a small PR to make code-stripper opt-in per-locale.

kevin: will also add microbench harness that computes kv-key cosine similarity between fp32 and ptq for a list of canonical JP phrases. Lia please add examples.

lia: on it. posting PR links and swap-list once complete.
